prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Stage layout redesign for friend selection screen: Redesign the pick_friend screen using a stage layout with a prominent spotlight preview stage for selecting pet companions.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "body": "Select a friend to join you on your desktop."}}
1: [home, new_screen] Interactive pet quickstart sandbox screen: Add an interactive quickstart sandbox screen before final home launch to teach users desktop pet interaction controls.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_pet_sandbox", "home_intro"], "new_pet_sandbox": {"headline": "Practice Interacting With Your Pet", "body": "Click, drag, or right-click your desktop pet to open controls.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful", "action": "open_tip"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Got It, Bring Pet to Desktop", "style": "highlight", "action": "next"}]}}
2: [home, redesign] Split layout redesign for desktop waiting screen: Rebuild the waiting screen with a split layout pairing real-time background setup status with interactive tip cards.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Setting Up Your Desktop Companion", "body": "We are preparing pet animations and desktop overlay scripts for first launch.", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true}}
3: [adoption, new_flow] Pet companion quiz interactive flow: Insert a short personality quiz screen before pet selection to recommend matching pet types based on user desktop habits.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "new_pet_quiz", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_quiz": {"headline": "Find Your Ideal Pet Personality", "body": "Answer 2 quick questions to discover which desktop companion suits your workflow best.", "layout": "card", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "style": "rounded", "action": "choose"}, {"type": "button", "label": "See Recommended Pets", "style": "highlight", "action": "next"}]}}
4: [finish, redesign] Full bleed layout redesign for home intro screen: Redesign the home intro screen into a full bleed hero layout highlighting the pet ready state and controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "body": "Look at the bottom corner of your primary monitor to see your new pet.", "button_label": "Start Playing"}}
5: [sign_in, hint] Account session persistence hint on sign-in screen: Display an explicit helper hint explaining that sign-in locks saved pets to your account across reinstalls and log-ins.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in links your adopted pet permanently so it is never lost on re-login."}}
6: [finish, copy] Desktop control guidance copy revision on home intro screen: Update the home intro body text to explain system tray access, hiding/showing, and dragging the pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"body": "Your pet lives on your desktop! Right-click the pet or check your system tray icon to hide, configure controls, or chat."}}
7: [home, wait_info] Desktop status loading animation on waiting screen: Add an animated desktop setup component displaying dynamic pet asset rendering progress.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:desktop_loader", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "progress", "style": "highlight"}]}}
8: [adoption, incentive] Starter pet habitat badge on adoption certificate: Add a starter desktop toy unlock badge to the adoption certificate screen celebrating completion.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Includes Starter Toy Pack", "style": "highlight"}]}}
9: [home, notification] Desktop companion completion sound notification toggle on waiting screen: Enable optional ready audio notification switch on the desktop waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We'll play a chime when your desktop pet finishes spawning."}}
